title: nan
authors: Chen L.-Y.; Lin H.-Y.; Munir S.
key_contribution: Presents a vision-based UAV localization framework using CLIP aerial-satellite image matching for GNSS-denied navigation, achieving position and heading estimates over a 2.23 km2 area.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
